## Checking model assumptions

```{r}
#| label: set-up
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(targets)
library(tarchetypes)

# Load the data
tar_load(diversity_model_checks)
tar_load(diversity_model_checks_ds_climate)
tar_load(diversity_model_checks_region_ds_climate)
tar_load(trait_model_checks)
tar_load(trait_model_checks_region)
```

## Diversity Models

```{r}
#| label: diversity-model-checks
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

diversity_model_checks |>
  select(diversity_index, model_check) |>
  pwalk(.f = function(diversity_index, model_check, ...) {
  cat("\n\n")
  diversity_heading <- if (identical(diversity_index, "diversity")) {
    "Shannon diversity"
  } else {
    stringr::str_to_title(diversity_index)
  }
  cat(paste("###", diversity_heading, "- latitude", "\n\n"))
  
  # Print the model check plots
  print(model_check)
  
  # Add spacing after the plot
  cat("\n\n")
})
  
```

## Diversity Climate Models (Global)

```{r}
#| label: diversity-climate-global-model-checks
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

diversity_model_checks_ds_climate |>
  select(climate_variable, model_check) |>
  pwalk(.f = function(climate_variable, model_check, ...) {
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(paste("### Shannon diversity -",
      case_when(
        climate_variable == "gs_length" ~ "Growing season length (days), global model",
        climate_variable == "gs_temperature" ~ "Growing season temperature (°C), global model",
        climate_variable == "gs_vpd" ~ "Growing season VPD, global model",
        climate_variable == "gdd" ~ "Growing degree days (>5°C), global model",
        climate_variable == "gs_diurnal_range" ~ "Diurnal range (°C), global model",
        TRUE ~ climate_variable
      ), "\n\n"
    ))

    print(model_check)
    cat("\n\n")
  })
```

## Trait Models

```{r}
#| label: trait-model-checks
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

trait_model_checks |> 
  filter(climate_variable %in% c("gs_length", "gs_temperature", "gs_vpd", "gdd", "gs_diurnal_range")) |>
  select(trait_trans, climate_variable, data_source, model_check) |> 
  pwalk(.f = function(trait_trans, climate_variable, data_source, model_check, ...){
  # Create a nice header with spacing
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(paste("###", stringr::str_replace_all(trait_trans, "_", " ") |> stringr::str_to_title(), "-", 
            case_when(
              climate_variable == "gs_length" ~ "Growing season length (days)",
              climate_variable == "gs_temperature" ~ "Growing season temperature (°C)",
              climate_variable == "gs_vpd" ~ "Growing season VPD",
              climate_variable == "gdd" ~ "Growing degree days (>5°C)",
              climate_variable == "gs_diurnal_range" ~ "Diurnal range (°C)",
              TRUE ~ climate_variable
            ), "\n\n"))
  
  # Print the model check plots
  print(model_check)
  
  # Add spacing after the plot
  cat("\n\n")
})
  
```
